poems.title: A love from Afar
poems.body:
A love from Afar
I never knew I could love and care about someone this much…
You are the light in my darkness,
the calm in the storms of my heart.

You are the fragrance I would never tire of.

Did a flower from heaven come down?
A flower unlike any other,
its scent filling the abyss
magnificent,
beautiful,
unreal.

I talked to Allah about you,
not out of desperation,
not out of infatuation,
but with love and care.

Every time I miss you,
it’s like I’m waiting for a dawn that never comes.
Every time I talk to you,
butterflies go wild in my stomach.

Your smile?
The highlight of my day.
Your eyes?
Moon-like .. I could stare at them for years.
Your voice?
Angel-like,
calm,
peaceful,
just perfect.

I love you through your weaknesses,
I love you through your happiness,
I love you with your flaws,
I love you with an intensity that makes words fumble.

My heart feels empty without you;
it needs YOU to be filled to the brim.

poems.title: Celebrity if my Universe!
poems.body:
I Turned to the moon...
For words of you...
Who never leaves my breath...

Silence was its reply-
Only a knowing glow,
As though my questions
Had long become a lullaby.

Then The wind passed by me
Carrying your fragrance.
Heavenly smell filled the abyss

Then i saw a dying star
And i asked "oh what happened"
He angrily answered.
"Im dying your beauty is outglowing me"
Wow...

It seemed that heaven already knew you
Before i spoke
It knew i was gonna talk about you.
Well... I was gonna ask if it knows the flower that 
Fills the gardens with freshenes
It said "Oh Boy the only flower that would do that is your lillies"
I blushed as if i didnt know it before...

Theres no night where,
I dont miss to ask the sky
If it has crossed paths with u

The moon veiled its gaze
The wind hides its almost too quiet grin.
The stars die with jealousy .

Until i realized
They are not keeping me away from u..

They are only wondering 
Wondering why i ask so much about someone
Who I carved into every corner of my universe.

poems.title: The flower that found my garden
poems.body:
I woke into darkness every day
Where colours faded away,
Clinging to a fading light
Holding on with all my might.

Then life began to bloom
Subtle yet noticeable,
A change written all by Him...
A change so unpredictable.

My heart once withered 
Began to bloom with  His mercy,
And among the flowers that grew
Were lilies and roses that reminded me of you

Written in the stars were constellations
Capturing a beauty unlike any other
A butterfly in a garden of blooms
Flying through it with endless mercy 


So if tomorrow calls us on,
Beyond the dreams we are passing through.
I will keep one flower in my heart 
Forever blooming, named for you.

poems.title: A star among galaxies
poems.body:
A star among galaxies
It Humbled me.

Stars envy, the moon hides, galaxies Watch.
Bright and sparkling,
The shades of Autumn in your eyes, a sun-kissed glow.

In a galaxy full of stars
I only see yours, i only seek yours

For what is a sky full of stars, if i have already found my sky?

poems.title: Heavenly Gadr
poems.body:
Hey hoor… even Aphrodite herself would fall silent at a single glance of your beauty.
It’s not earthly,
it’s heavenly 
immense, unreal beauty.

You drown me without water.
You make me high without drugs.

You are like a medicine 
one glance and I’m cured.

Wallah, I want you in my life,
not to harm you,
nor to make you sad,
but to make you happy,
and to love you.

I have a whole ocean of love in my heart just for you.

Oh hoor… I wish you knew how much I love you,
how much I long for you,
how much I want to be with you.

If your love was a bullet, I would take it without a doubt 
shoot it right into my heart.

If love hurts,
I would be more than happy
to love you.

If you are written for me,
Not even the distance of thousand worlds
Can keep you away.
And if Allah brings your blessed heart to mine
That will be my sweetest gadr

poems.title: Time was but a Friend
poems.body:
Time didn’t heal me.
Time just showed me I’m not worth it.
Time made me realise I’m useless,
that I gave my effort to people who never cared.

I love the wrong people.
I hate myself for it.
I hate it.

Love is something I still haven’t touched.
I don’t know how it feels 
I only know caring and lies.
I know betrayal better than affection.

I lost hope in love.
I lost hope in marriage.
I lost hope in anything attached to the word “love.”

It sucks to be me.

I cared.
I loved.
I stayed through highs and lows.
But when I was at my lowest, people left.
They hurt me.
They betrayed me.
They shouted at me.

So my heart never learned.
It’s still in pieces
that don’t fit anymore.

It sucks.

poems.title: Lonely starfish
poems.body:
With hopes of five , i reach
No one to support,
No one to help,

From deep to the shore,
I raise with no hand to hold,
Stretching to the sky,

Now all alone on the sand,
Drying from the heat,
No one to help,
No one to touch.
 
Its fate....all along

poems.title: Oh Moon!
poems.body:
Moon....
Such a beauty
Snapped by everyone 

Oh moon,
Come a bit closer,
Let me admire your beauty alone.

Let me devour  your gentle glow
Your grey shimmering glow.
The same light that touches a thousand
Yet feels like its mine

Let me have you for a bit longer
Not let the dark take u away from me
For i love you more than the night

poems.title: Beach
poems.body:
Claming and charming,
Blue and white,
Full of life natures delight 

Joyous experience 
Beautiful weather
Sunny skies and gentl weather

Wet sand
Wind in the air
Seagulls flying

Waves keep calling 
Shoreline singing 
Beautiful moment

Best of the best
Natures choice 
Beach is truly a blessing

poems.title: The ocean secrets
poems.body:
Some untold tales sleep within the deep
Some wander ashore with every wave.
While others buried far below.
Some inconceivable to explain, yet Every one is cloaked in stillness 

Fishesh hear the whispers of the seafloor 
While birds gossip about the mystery of the sealine.

poems.title: Mother
poems.body:
O my heart’s peace,
my first love,
the heaven beneath your feet,
my ultimate peace,
my beloved mother.
How precious you are to me.
Your son will forever love you.
Forgive me for every pain you endured because of me.
I miss your warmth,
your smile,
the joy of my heart.
O Lord, please keep her safe she is so dear to me.

poems.title: Cats
poems.body:
Cuddle buddy, soft and cute,
Tiny paws and  sleepy eyes,
Curled up cozy, out of sight.

Whiskers twitch, paws so neat,
Silent hunter, glowing eyes ,
Soft to touch, leaping high.

Calm and trusty, frnd of mine,
A kind heart thats all divine .

poems.title: Chocolate cake
poems.body:
Rich like nightfall, tender with vice.
a concealed necter lingers beneath.
Cozy Cocoa softens across my mouth
An endless desire awakens at once.

The glaze gleams, creamy and slow.
With whispers of delight only i know.
I taste a lone morsel, and suddenly realize.
Certain pleasures are most enjoyable unveiled with every bite
